provenance.vehicle_overall_dimensions: User-provided vehicle size image: 99 cm x 55 cm x 41 cm.
provenance.wheel_material: User identified the wheel material as polyurethane.
provenance.transverse_geometry: Estimated from assets/source/vehicle_front_profile.png using the known 0.55 m overall width: both front/rear track 0.47 m and tire width 0.08 m. User confirmed equal front/rear geometry and authorized an approximate value.
provenance.map_dimensions: Originally interpreted as 13.0 m x 9.0 m. Texture measurements against the official specification sheet (road width 850 mm, parking pitch 950 mm, crosswalk stripe 100 mm) showed all area features uniformly ~14-25% small, so the user authorized rescaling by k = 850 / 732.5 = 1.1604096 anchored on the measured line-center-to-line-center road width; parking pitch (k=1.170) and crosswalk stripe width (k=1.163) independently agree. Result: 15.0853242321 m x 10.4436860068 m with the drawing aspect ratio preserved. Painted line widths render ~59 mm versus the 50 mm specification because the source artwork draws strokes out of scale.
provenance.spawn: Rear axle originally at (-5.50, 1.08) m, scaled by the same k=1.1604096 map rescale to (-6.3822525597, 1.2532423208) m, yaw -90 deg, keeping the front bumper on the left Start line in the outer lane with initial counterclockwise travel.
provenance.steering_command: User specified straight command 0 and a command range of -100..100. Physical maximum wheel angles remain unmeasured.
provenance.steering_position_sensor: User identified the steering position sensor as ELB030640 (20 kOhm), confirmed a 1:1 relationship between potentiometer travel and road-wheel steering, and authorized the derived symmetric maximum road-wheel angle of +/-18.0791788855 deg.
provenance.zero_pwm_behavior: User confirmed that drive PWM 0 behaves as braking.
provenance.drive_speed_measurement: User measured 1.0 m in 1.75 s at forward PWM 255 (0.571428571429 m/s), confirmed equal reverse endpoint speed, and explicitly authorized linear interpolation for all remaining PWM values outside the firmware deadband. The user later reported a real lap time of 47-48 s and authorized recalibrating the PWM 255 endpoint from lap time; after the k=1.1604096 map rescale the outer-lane path is ~36.96 m, giving 0.778 m/s (supersedes the interim 0.667 m/s derived on the undersized map). The reverse endpoint is scaled to match.
provenance.drive_speed_response: User explicitly authorized instantaneous target-speed response with no simulated acceleration or braking delay.
provenance.camera_measurement: User specified Logitech C922, 640x480 images, camera height 0.80 m above ground, centered lateral mounting, and forward yaw. Logitech specifies 70.42 deg horizontal FOV. A user-provided modified-vehicle side photograph estimates the lens at +0.067 m forward of the rear axle. Rendered comparison at -10, -17, and -20 deg selected -17 deg because only a small part of the vehicle enters the bottom edge. The user authorized recording 30 fps, the C922 standard capture rate at 640x480, pending an exact measurement.
provenance.lidar_measurement: User specified the LiDAR is mounted at the front center of the vehicle on a bumper adapter. The user-provided LD_Adaptor.stl measures 120 x 80 x 25 mm with a 10 mm mounting wall at one end and the four sensor standoffs centered 69 mm ahead of that wall, so the sensor rotation center sits about 0.069 m ahead of the 0.801 m front body end: 0.87 m forward of the rear axle, laterally centered. The rotation center is assumed at the standoff-pattern center. The raw-angle convention (front=raw 180, ros=180-raw) comes from ctrl_zero/lidar.py, confirmed on the physical car with lidar_probe.py. Simulated range limit 12 m, 1 deg step, and 10 Hz scan rate follow the RPLidar A1 class sensor; the exact sensor model remains unmeasured. The mission state machine is stepped once per simulated scan so debounce frame counts see a realistic rate.
provenance.parking_scenario: Parking bay geometry is measured from the generated track texture in the rescaled world frame: divider centers x = -0.873, 0.069, 1.010, 1.954, 2.898 m, bay top y = 1.532 m, bay mouth y = 0.220 m, aisle south boundary y = -1.436 m, entry line x = 3.879 m. Obstacle cars use the own-vehicle footprint 0.99 x 0.55 m per user authorization. The four 3 cm start markers ARE drawn on the map beside the IN text and were measured from the texture at (4.121,-0.749), (4.121,-0.461), (4.433,-0.749), (4.433,-0.461) m with blob sizes 29-33 mm, independently confirming the 3 cm specification square after the map rescale. The marker sits under the right front wheel with the vehicle heading west; markers 1/3 are the south column, 2/4 the north column.
provenance.unknown_policy: A null physical or hardware parameter is a hard error. It is never replaced by a fallback or estimate.
